rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person's motto or a stated guiding principle.

example.english: My motto is, “Finish today’s work today.”
example.traditional: 我嘅座右銘係「今日事今日畢」。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 zo6 jau6 ming4 hai6 gam1 jat6 si6 gam1 jat6 bat1

rows.note: Use this when the motto is a public or campaign-style slogan rather than a personal maxim.

example.english: The motto of this campaign is, “Everyone should protect the oceans.”
example.traditional: 呢個活動嘅口號係「人人都要愛護海洋」。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wut6 dung6 ge3 hau2 hou6 hai6 jan4 jan4 dou1 jiu3 oi3 wu6 hoi2 joeng4

rows.note: Use this for a general maxim or moral saying rather than a person's adopted slogan.

example.english: This motto reminds me to stay grounded.
example.traditional: 呢句格言提醒我做人要腳踏實地。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 gaak3 jin4 tai4 sing2 ngo5 zou6 jan4 jiu3 goek3 daap6 sat6 dei6

rows.note: Use this only for a literary epigraph placed before a work or section.

example.english: This essay begins with a motto.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章以一句題辭開首。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ji5 jat1 geoi3 tai4 ci4 hoi1 sau2
